description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
